title: Alex Hormozi on starting small, paying down ignorance debt, and building a $150M portfolio
summary: Hormozi walks through how to go from zero to six figures: pick one channel, one product, one avatar, start a service business from what you already know, and treat early income as education. He covers his gym story, front-loaded offers, why investing in skills beats the S&P 500, and his content vendor-to-in-house playbook.

principles.text: Start with a service business built on what you already know; the early goal is to learn, not earn.
principles.quote: you're trading that time for money in order to learn not to earn you need to earn in order to pay your pay your rent eat Etc but the the major thing you're doing is you're paying down ignorance debt

principles.text: You don't need a novel idea: copy what others do and do it a little better by fixing what people hate.
principles.quote: the best way to start a business is just look at what everyone else is doing and just try and do it better

principles.text: Don't plan 100 steps ahead; take a step and the next one becomes clear. Expect a graveyard of failures.
principles.quote: once you start taking steps The Next Step becomes illuminated you trying to think 100 steps into the future when you have no context is is irrelevant because chaos is going to break your plan anyways

principles.text: Favors people ask of you signal what you can charge for; mine past jobs, parents' industries and interests for offers.
principles.quote: what people ask you to do as a favor is an indication of the things you can charge for later

principles.text: Six figures needs one channel, one product, one avatar; seven figures is doing that consistently.
principles.quote: getting to six figures is literally just like sell something to someone like that's that's all you have to do to get six records like one channel one product one Avatar like that's it

principles.text: Invest in your earning capacity before markets; income problems aren't investing problems.
principles.quote: you will get a significantly higher return investing in your own ability to make money than you will in any any market
